consumer_implementation: T2 remains a separate task; this file defines the evidence boundary only
authoritative_text: original_fragments, exact original fragments and their separate page/bbox/text anchors; CSV is one row per fragment
figure_semantics: Whole figure assets/captions and explicit pairing remain distinct from pending/proposed pairing. Never infer image approval from text approval.
approval_rule: Only current version and fingerprint-bound human confirmation is approved. Candidate, background, model assessment and source fidelity are not medical approval.
source_guard: Missing/changed PDF or IR prevents new extraction and approved exports. A changed/unavailable figure invalidates image confirmation while unchanged approved text may remain exportable without that image.
group_rule: Same-source review groups are read-only hints. Keep every member/version; no automatic merge or approval propagation.
consumer_rule: Read manifest/coverage/reviews first; preserve origin, fixture and scope completeness. Only approved text can become confirmed evidence; only separately approved figure relations can constrain visual use. Do not fill gaps or paraphrase source text.
source_glyph_rule: New runs require the source glyph check; quarantined blocks are neither delivered nor counted complete. Read source_glyph_check and coverage. Legacy unchecked IR remains viewable but approved export is conservative; no automatic approval migration.
finalization_rule: Only result_ready final snapshots/coverage describe terminal processing. A downloadable partial candidate package is not completed extraction or medical approval.
